title: BPW-2026-0552
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0552
CD ALL
TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) S-068 – STANTEC CONSULTING SERVICES, INC. (STANTEC)
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation (BOS) or designee to award TOS S-068 to Stantec from the On-Call Consultant list;
APPROVE a total budget of $2,659,692 to provide model development, maintenance, and refinement for BOS’s Conveyance System and Water Reclamation Plants; and
APPROVE the 24-month term of engagement beginning with the Notice-to-Proceed date. Term of engagement not to exceed June 30, 2029.
(W.O.: S10NCSWR, C-145666)
summary: Awards a $2,659,692 Bureau of Sanitation task order to Stantec for model development, maintenance and refinement of the Conveyance System and Water Reclamation Plants, over a 24-month term.
